review_note: Retains fppf-locality on the target of property f is an immersion (locally closed immersion), including descent and ascent under arbitrary fppf covering.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\{g_i:Y_i\to Y\}$ an fppf covering. Then $f$ is an immersion (factorable as an open immersion followed by a closed immersion) if and only if for every $i$ the base change $X\times_YY_i\to Y_i$ is an immersion.
hypotheses: f:X→Y and an fppf cover of Y.
conclusions: Being an immersion is fppf-local on the target.

review_note: Retains fppf-locality on target of dominance (image dense in Y) for scheme morphisms, including the all-members/if-and-only-if quantifier.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism and $\{g_i:Y_i\to Y\}$ an fppf covering. Then $f$ is dominant (its set-theoretic image is dense in $Y$) if and only if every base-changed morphism $f_i:X\times_YY_i\to Y_i$ is dominant.
hypotheses: f:X→Y and an fppf covering of Y.
conclusions: Dominance is fppf-local on the target.
